inputs.style:
Heavy thrash metal with raw, aggressive energy. Features dual lead guitars, rapid drumming, and guttural English vocals. The mood is intense and visceral, driven by a pounding groove and sharp riffs. The track builds to a chaotic climax before a abrupt, heavy ending.. Producer style: Thrash Metal. Roles: guitar: Distorted lead and rhythm guitars, heavy palm muting and fast alternate picking; bass: Aggressive electric bass, tracking the guitar riffs tightly; drums: Fast double-bass drumming, sharp snare hits, and intense cymbal crashes; vocals: Guttural, aggressive English vocals with high energy and raw tone. Form: Intro 0-12s energy 0.8 lead guitar; Verse 1 12-36s energy 0.6 lead vocals; Pre-Chorus 36-44s energy 0.7 lead vocals; Chorus 44-60s energy 0.9 lead vocals; Verse 2 60-84s energy 0.6 lead vocals; Pre-Chorus 84-92s energy 0.7 lead vocals; Chorus 92-108s energy 0.9 lead vocals; Bridge 108-124s energy 0.8 lead guitar; Chorus 124-140s energy 0.95 lead vocals; Outro 140-180s energy 0.5 lead guitar. Complete ending.

Reserve the last 8 seconds for the final chord decay and silence. Finish all sung words before the outro. No endless loop, unfinished solo, or long fade-out. Write explicit measures, no repeat signs; keep intro and interludes brief.. Qwen producer tempo 165 BPM. inputs.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
Blood drips from the stone
The forest floor is known
Bare feet on the cold ground
Where the weak are unbound

[Pre-Chorus]
We dig, we dig
Till the sky begins to crack

[Chorus]
Roots Bloody Roots
Drinking deep from the soil's mouth
Roots Bloody Roots
Holding on, holding on

[Verse]
Iron teeth in the dark
Piercing through the bark
We bleed into the dirt
Born from the birth

[Pre-Chorus]
We dig, we dig
Till the sky begins to crack

[Chorus]
Roots Bloody Roots
Drinking deep from the soil's mouth
Roots Bloody Roots
Holding on, holding on

[Bridge]
No sky, no sun
Just the pulse of the one
Beneath the skin
Where it begins

[Chorus]
Roots Bloody Roots
Drinking deep from the soil's mouth
Roots Bloody Roots
Holding on, holding on

[Outro]
Holding on... (Feedback swell)
Final Chord Decay
Silence
